query:
-- Verificar os asaas_charge_id dos 4 registros problemáticos
SELECT bc.id, bc.asaas_charge_id, bc.type, bc.value/100 as valor_atual,
       fr.asaas_charge_id as fr_charge_id, fr.total_amount/100 as valor_correto
FROM bpo_charges bc
LEFT JOIN fuel_records fr ON bc.asaas_charge_id = fr.asaas_charge_id
WHERE bc.id IN (900001, 900002, 900003, 900004);
